title: ‘Performance of the UN and UNSC has been DEEPLY disappointing’ — Iran’s Masoud Pezeshkian
text:
‘Performance of the UN and UNSC has been DEEPLY disappointing’ — Iran’s Masoud Pezeshkian "

"He noted that the UN and UNSC have poorly addressed global challenges, including military aggression, genocide, terrorism, and developments in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran
